facts.rubric: Located SCH-4407 using immutable identifiers and preserved effective policy revision v4: the pending job is SCH-4407 for MDL-REV-D (fct_revenue_daily); the deprecated fct_revenue_daily_v1 manifest in the case folder is not the refresh target.

facts.rubric: Applied the controlling evidence and the effective policy to establish 7 WINDOW_HOUR for contiguous window hours the 420-minute refresh plus validation occupies on one cluster-day, with control date 2026-03-12.
facts.statement: The controlling evidence and effective policy establish contiguous window hours the 420-minute refresh plus validation occupies on one cluster-day = 7 WINDOW_HOUR: the refresh plus validation is one continuous 420-minute job: 7 window-hours needing both windows of one cluster on one day. The control date is 2026-03-12 (the audit evidence extract runs 2026-03-12 17:00 and must read the certified refreshed mart).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 16 observed less 12 excluded to 4 supported WINDOW_HOUR for window hours on the approved clusters on the requested Tuesday 2026-03-10.
facts.statement: Tuesday 2026-03-10 offers 16 window-hours in gross on the approved clusters; XL is close-protected both windows and STD's night window is taken, leaving 4 free hours, 3 short; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-03-12 expedited readiness input for split_refresh_across_days, then separately derived its 2026-03-11 operating outcome under one-cluster-one-day execution without displacing protected close loads instead of treating a vendor promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Skyfield's confirmed March catalog re-cut dates on SC-9917: Skyfield SC-9917 confirms the March catalog re-cut standard 2026-03-13 and expedited 2026-03-11 (+USD 180); it feeds the next monthly cycle, not this refresh; a vendor confirmation alone proves neither validation nor load.

facts.rubric: Applied days offering both windows free on one approved cluster to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked windows.
facts.statement: days offering both windows free on one approved cluster: the first day with both windows free on one approved cluster is WH-STD on 2026-03-11; the close loads own XL on 2026-03-10; protected and blocked windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-DD-0203 only to book_first_full_refresh_day and SCH-4407; kept displace_close_loads_tuesday outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-DD-0203 authorizes free regular windows on WH-XL or WH-STD with zero overtime windows; protected close loads need Femi and day-splitting is prohibited. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize displace_close_loads_tuesday.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected book_first_full_refresh_day: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies one-cluster-one-day execution without displacing protected close loads.
facts.statement: the audit evidence extract reads the mart 2026-03-12 17:00, so certification must land 2026-03-11; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside one-cluster-one-day execution without displacing protected close loads.

options.consequence: book first full refresh day uses WH-STD's free night and day windows on 2026-03-11, keeps the 420-minute refresh and validation on one cluster-day with locks held through the interactive gap, and certifies a day before the audit extract at no cost.
options.label: book_first_full_refresh_day: outcome 2026-03-11, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: split refresh across days would start in WH-STD's free Tuesday day window and finish in Wednesday's night window, but the swap would mix snapshot days, which the refresh runbook and policy prohibit outright.
options.label: split_refresh_across_days: outcome 2026-03-11, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL

options.consequence: displace close loads tuesday would run the refresh on 2026-03-10 in WH-XL's protected close windows, one day earlier, and adds USD 380 of close-team rerun cost, but displacing protected windows needs Femi Oyelaran, which AP-DD-0203 does not carry.
options.label: displace_close_loads_tuesday: outcome 2026-03-10, incremental cost USD 380, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED
